text: Why is population inversion impossible in a two-level system under steady resonant optical pumping?
choices: Stimulated emission does not occur in a two-level system
Because B₁₂ = B₂₁, pumping can at best equalize the populations (N₂/N₁ → 1) but never invert them
Spontaneous emission is far too slow to matter
The pump photons carry the wrong energy for the transition
explanation: Since stimulated absorption and emission have equal rates (B₁₂ = B₂₁), increasing pump intensity drives N₂/N₁ toward 1 but never above it, so no inversion. Stimulated emission does occur and resonant pump photons have the right energy; the barrier is the symmetry of the two rates, which three- and four-level schemes evade.
